title: PoliticianWatch SA public-role profile
description: A sourced, labelled profile of an elected representative in their public role only. No ID numbers, home addresses, personal phones or emails, private family, or health information. Unknown fields are explicit nulls with label Unknown. Every adverse item requires a right_of_reply object.

court_matters.description: Adverse court or criminal matters. Empty if none recorded yet. Each item requires right_of_reply.

scandals.description: Adverse scandal or allegation items. Empty if none recorded yet. Each item requires right_of_reply.

slug.description: File slug derived from the gazetted name.

change.description: Change record that added or last changed this profile, e.g. CHG-PW-002.

known_as.description: Public name used in reporting, when it differs from the gazetted name. Optional.

cv.description: CV-style public-role entries (positions, career, candidacy, education). Each entry is a labelled, sourced fact. Optional; empty if none sourced.

unknown_fields.description: Fields deliberately left Unknown (shown as visible placeholders).

given_names.description: Given names as stated by a source, when the gazetted name differs from the public name. Optional.

full_name_surname.description: Surname as part of the full legal name, when not confirmed by a source (label Unknown). Optional.

retrieved_at.description: When the source was fetched. Either an ISO 8601 datetime with a UTC offset (the logged fetch time, taken from fetch provenance: `pwatch fetch-source` / the raw manifest) or a date only, YYYY-MM-DD, when the fetch time was not logged (read as the end of that day, SAST). Never type a time by hand. pwatch dq fails any value later than the run time (CHG-PW-003 fixes 2-3).

also_sourced.description: Further sources for the same fact. Each needs source_url, source_date and retrieved_at.

retrieved_at.description: When the source was fetched. Either an ISO 8601 datetime with a UTC offset (the logged fetch time, taken from fetch provenance: `pwatch fetch-source` / the raw manifest) or a date only, YYYY-MM-DD, when the fetch time was not logged (read as the end of that day, SAST). Never type a time by hand. pwatch dq fails any value later than the run time (CHG-PW-003 fixes 2-3).

matter_status.description: 'reported_conviction' = a conviction known only from news reporting, with no judgment citation found in allowed sources.

outcome.description: Current outcome or status as reported, in neutral words.

identity_link_label.description: Label for the link between this item's source and the gazetted person. When it is not Confirmed, the item itself must not be labelled Confirmed.

deadline.description: Null while pending and unsent: the owner sets it on sending (see deadline_rule). Required once status is sent, replied or no_response.

reply_text.description: Blank (null) until the owner records a reply. Profiles show an empty reply field while pending.

recorded_by.description: Must be 'owner' when status is sent, replied, or no_response. The bot never records a send or reply.

deadline_rule.description: How the deadline is set, e.g. '14 days after the owner sends'.

identity_match.description: How non-gazette sources were linked to this gazetted person. At least two independent details must match (CHG-PW-002 rule).
